purpose: Verify the current StarSupply build after fixing unresolved entity callbacks during plugin shutdown and diagnosing the Folia acceptance runtime.
regressions: Plugin shutdown exceptionally completes queued entity operations so dependent inventory guards are released even when plugin task cancellation does not call the scheduler retirement handler.
Callbacks already running retain ownership of their completion; late, retired, rejected and cancelled callbacks cannot claim a second execution.
A 100-iteration scheduler/shutdown race completes every operation exactly once, either successfully or exceptionally.
StarSupply checks that StarCore is enabled before binding its public API.

acceptance_tool_tests.scope: Plugin readiness and failure detection, separate stdout/stderr decoding, Windows console encoding, shutdown errors, native/client memory headroom and rejecting optimistic crafting without a saved survival pickaxe.

limits: Automated lifecycle tests do not establish live world-unload or Folia entity-retirement recovery.
The production descriptor continues to target Paper. Isolated Folia runs use a descriptor-only test override.
Earlier runtime records remain associated with their original artifact hashes.
